com.nokia.midp.example.jsr234.audio3d
Class Audio3DCanvas

java.lang.Object
  javax.microedition.lcdui.Displayable
      javax.microedition.lcdui.Canvas
          com.nokia.midp.example.jsr234.audio3d.Audio3DCanvas

public class Audio3DCanvas
extends javax.microedition.lcdui.Canvas

Canvas class to display User Interface with the sound Source movement. UI gives facility to move sound source 3D to see the sound effect using UP,DOWN.LEFT and RIGHT keys.

gothadiy
